name: IRI-VFI: pediatric interventional radiology image sequences (Chongqing)
what: 95,308 real fluoroscopy images in 1,357 sequences with the lumbar spine in field; pediatric, DSA subtraction frames to be excluded
how_to_get: Open https://ieee-dataport.org/documents/iri-vfi-dataset signed in to an IEEE account (free); read the licence line and whether the files are open access or need a DataPort subscription.
Fetch to Ceph as a Slurm job; read the terms before any derived label.
